Definition: Whether the country has established or is actively developing an instant/real-time payment system (IPS/RTP) that enables digital payments with near-instant settlement (typically within seconds), available 24/7/365. This includes both bank-led and mobile money interoperability systems.
Comments: Botswana has Bank of Botswana-operated national payment systems including the Botswana Interbank Settlement System (BISS), an RTGS that transfers funds in real time between participating institutions, and is interfaced with the Botswana Automated Clearing House (BACH) for net settlement ([Bank of Botswana – BISS](https://www.bankofbotswana.bw/content/botswana-interbank-settlement-system)). Because evidence found is for RTGS (high-value, business-hours) and batch retail clearing, but not for a 24/7 low-value inclusive instant payment system, score as partially deployed rather than fully deployed inclusive IPS.
